description: This file declares interfaces and constants related to handling pack mtime information in a version control or data storage system. It includes function prototypes for loading mtime data and retrieving mtime values for objects within a packed git object structure.

methods.name: load_pack_mtimes
methods.description: Loads the .mtimes file for a given packed_git object, returning zero on success.

methods.name: nth_packed_mtime
methods.description: Returns the modification time (mtime) for an object at a specified position within a pack.
